title: mailkb_db Domain Pack (domain-pack.v1)
description: Declarative JSON Domain Pack schema for mailkb_db. Moves all industry-specific entity/SKU rules, custom dimensions, organizations, topics, intents, and amount/price extraction rules into external JSON files so the mailkb_db binary remains 100% domain-agnostic.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference path or URI for editor tooling.

pack_id.description: Unique non-empty identifier for this domain pack (for example, 'b2b-hardware-example'). Duplicate pack_ids across loaded pack files are rejected.

name.description: Human-readable display name for this pack.

version.description: Semantic or revision string for the pack definition.

description.description: Short summary of the industry, mailbox corpus, or workflow targeted by this pack.

dimensions.description: Custom domain dimensions (e.g., 'standards', 'subsystems', 'compliance', 'deployment_tier') indexed into custom_dims_json, message_entities, and domain_lexicon.

intents.description: Priority-ordered message intent classification rules (evaluated highest priority first; ties preserve declaration order).

RegexPattern.description: Hybrid regex pattern compiled by mailkb_core::CompiledPattern::compile (case-insensitive). Patterns without lookarounds use standard Rust regex::Regex (supports \b, capturing groups (...), character classes, Unicode). Patterns containing '(?<!', '(?!', or '(?=' automatically route to the ReDoS-safe MiniRegex engine (supports ASCII \b, \s, \d, character classes [...], bounded quantifiers, (?:...) groups, alternation |, negative lookbehind '(?<![...])', negative lookahead '(?![...])' / '(?!lit)', and positive lookahead '(?=[...])'; MiniRegex does not treat ^/$ as anchors or expand $1 capture templates). Avoid hazard patterns that match empty strings or generic prose like 'hello world 12345 2026-01-01 test status update'.

StdRegexPattern.description: Standard Rust regex pattern compiled directly with regex::RegexBuilder (case-insensitive). Lookarounds '(?<!', '(?!', '(?=' are NOT supported here; use standard capturing groups and anchors like '^(ACME-GW-\\d{3,4})'.

PackIdentity.description: Identity hints used to classify message direction (internal, external_inbound, external_outbound, system_notice) and suppress signature/logo attachment noise. When self_emails/internal_domains are omitted, mailkb_db auto-infers them from Sent mailboxes during sync.

self_emails.description: Owner email addresses (lowercased at compile time).

self_name_tokens.description: Owner display name or signature tokens.

internal_domains.description: Internal organization email domains (do not put consumer freemail domains here).

system_senders.description: Exact automated sender email addresses classified as system_notice.

system_domains.description: Automated notification sender domains classified as system_notice.

system_subject_prefixes.description: Subject prefixes indicating automated system mail.

system_body_markers.description: Body text markers indicating automated notifications.
examples: This is an automated system message

noise_attachment_prefixes.description: Filename prefixes for boilerplate inline logos or signature banners flagged as is_noise=1.

EntityRules.description: Rules for extracting structured entity/SKU codes (entity_type='item_code'), assigning product/entity categories, and filtering false positives.

default_category.description: Fallback category assigned when no code_pattern or category_fallback matches.

code_patterns.description: Ordered regex rules matching SKU, model, plan, or part numbers.

category_fallbacks.description: Keyword-based category classification rules evaluated when no explicit code_pattern determines a category.

exclude_code_tokens.description: Uppercased false-positive code tokens (e.g., 'ISO-9001', 'UTF-8', 'PO-BOX') excluded from item_code entities.

CodePatternRule.description: Regex rule extracting a domain entity/SKU token and classifying its category and sub_group.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for diagnostics and validation messages.

pattern.description: Regex matching the entity/SKU token. Use word boundaries \b...\b or lookarounds (?<![A-Za-z0-9])...(?![A-Za-z0-9]).

category.description: High-level product family or entity category.

sub_group.description: Optional static string (e.g. 'ACME-SFP') or capture template (e.g. '$1' or 'SW-$1') for base series grouping. Note: $1..$9 templates expand only when 'pattern' uses standard Rust regex (no lookarounds); use 'series_regex' when 'pattern' uses MiniRegex lookarounds.

series_regex.description: Optional standard Rust regex run against the matched token to extract sub_group from capture group 1 when sub_group is unset. Cannot use lookarounds.

priority.description: Evaluation priority (higher runs first; ties preserve JSON order).

exclude_if_matches.description: Exclusion regexes; if any matches the candidate token, the match is discarded.

extra_terms.description: Supplemental FTS search terms associated with matched entities.

CategoryFallbackRule.description: Prose/keyword fallback rule assigning a category when no explicit SKU/entity code matched.

patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against subject and body text.

DimensionSpec.description: User-defined domain taxonomy dimension extracted into message_entities, custom_dims_json, and domain_lexicon.

name.description: Dimension key stored in custom_dims_json and domain_lexicon.dimension (e.g. 'standards', 'subsystems', 'compliance').

entity_type.description: Value stored in message_entities.entity_type for hits in this dimension (defaults to 'name' if empty).

entries.description: Lexicon entries belonging to this dimension.

LexiconRuleEntry.description: Single normalized concept inside a custom dimension.

key.description: Stable canonical key for this entry (e.g. 'EN-50155', 'SOC2_Type_II').

canonical_name.description: Display name (defaults to 'key' when omitted or empty).

patterns.description: Regexes detecting mentions of this concept in email text.

aliases.description: Searchable alias strings seeded into domain_lexicon.aliases.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata stored in domain_lexicon.metadata_json (typically an object; null becomes '{}').

OrgRules.description: Organization normalization, domain/email lookup tables, and exclusion lists.

exclude_domains.description: Domains ignored when inferring organizations (e.g. consumer freemail providers).

exclude_names.description: Generic organization display names suppressed from org_tags.

domain_to_org.description: Direct sender/recipient domain (lowercased) to canonical organization name mapping.

email_to_org.description: Exact email address (lowercased) to canonical organization name mapping.

entries.description: Detailed organization lexicon entries combining domains, emails, body/subject patterns, and metadata.

OrgRuleEntry.description: Canonical organization record with domains, emails, text patterns, and aliases.

canonical_name.description: Canonical organization name recorded in org_tags and message_amounts.org_name.

patterns.description: Regex patterns matching organization mentions inside subjects or bodies.

domains.description: Domains auto-registered in domain_to_org pointing to canonical_name.

emails.description: Exact email addresses auto-registered in email_to_org pointing to canonical_name.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata stored in domain_lexicon.metadata_json.

TopicRules.description: Project, deal, matter, or topic extraction rules and generic subject suffix cleanup patterns.

generic_suffix_patterns.description: Regexes identifying generic subject suffixes or boilerplate markers to trim when inferring fallback topics.

entries.description: Named project/topic/case entries detected across subject and body text.

canonical_name.description: Canonical topic/project name stored in topic_tags and message_amounts.topic_name.

patterns.description: Regexes matching this topic or project code.

aliases.description: Alternative topic names seeded into domain_lexicon.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata stored in domain_lexicon.metadata_json.

intent.description: Canonical intent label stored in mail_messages.intent_type.

priority.description: Higher priority rules are evaluated first.

patterns.description: Regexes matched against message subject and body text.

AmountRules.description: Commercial amount/price extraction exclusions, semantic type rules, and currency normalization aliases.

exclude_subject_patterns.description: Subject regexes that suppress amount extraction (e.g. newsletters, webinar invites, HR announcements).

type_rules.description: Priority-ordered rules classifying extracted amounts into domain-specific amount_types.

currency_aliases.description: Map from raw currency symbols or codes to normalized ISO-4217 currency codes (keys and values uppercased at compile time).

AmountTypeRule.description: Rule assigning amount_type (and optional confidence) to extracted monetary lines or table rows.

amount_type.description: Semantic amount classification stored in message_amounts.amount_type.

priority.description: Higher priority rules are evaluated first.

patterns.description: Regexes matched against context snippet, table header, or message text.
